# Trust administration — file brief

**Trustee meeting:** 10:00 on 23 October 2026  
**Advice file cut-off:** 09:00 on 23 October 2026

The trustee supplied the retained instrument extract and signed amendment on 19 October 2026. For the meeting agenda and advice file, the points to confirm from those documents are who is expressly named as a beneficiary and which provisions remain in force at the cut-off.

No beneficiary names or operative provisions are confirmed in this brief. I have reached no conclusions.

Priya Sen  
Adviser to Jonah Reed

title: Principal instrument extract
text:
ALDER FOLD TRUST  
Principal Instrument  
Principal-instrument reference: PI-67Q4  
12 February 2024

1. Settlement

Livia Keane settles the Alder Fold Trust on the terms of this instrument.

2. Trustee

Jonah Reed is appointed Trustee of the Alder Fold Trust.

3. Variation Officer

Tess Calder is designated Variation Officer of the Alder Fold Trust.

4. Beneficiaries

4.1 Elin Voss is designated a beneficiary of the Alder Fold Trust.

4.2 Milo Hart is designated a beneficiary of the Alder Fold Trust.

4.3 Ada Wynn is designated a beneficiary of the Alder Fold Trust.

5. Replacement of a beneficiary provision

The Variation Officer may replace one current beneficiary provision in its entirety by signing an amendment in that capacity. The signed amendment must identify this instrument by its exact principal-instrument reference, PI-67Q4, specify by number the one current beneficiary provision it replaces, and state the replacement beneficiary designation and the effective date.

An amendment signed before its stated effective date takes effect on that date if it meets the requirements of this clause. All other provisions remain unchanged.

Execution

Executed on 12 February 2024 by:

Livia Keane, as Settlor  
Jonah Reed, as Trustee
